headline: Silver Rises 3.31 Percent to $51.23 as Precious Metals Take the Bid
narrative: Silver rose 3.31 percent to $51.23, money moving into the precious-metals pipe. Gold rose 1.92 percent to $4,016.1, and the gold pipe took the bid with silver. Copper fell 0.13 percent to $6.37, so industrial metals stayed out of the precious-metals move.
author: jordan
